questions.question: What does a two-way frequency table organize?
choices: Only the mean of one numerical variable
Counts for two categorical variables
The slope of two linear functions
Only the largest observation in a data set

questions.question: What is a marginal total in a two-way table?
choices: A row or column total
The product of two cell counts
The difference between the largest and smallest cell
The median of all cell counts

questions.question: What does P(A given B) describe?
choices: The probability of B among outcomes satisfying A
The probability that neither A nor B occurs
The sum of the probabilities of A and B
The probability of A among outcomes satisfying B

questions.question: Which denominator is used to find the proportion of bus riders among ninth graders?
choices: The total number of bus riders in the school
The total number of tenth graders
The total number of ninth graders
The number of ninth-grade bus riders

questions.question: What is a joint frequency?
choices: The total count in the entire table
The count in a cell representing two categories together
The larger of two row totals
The sum of every column total

questions.question: Among 40 students who play an instrument, 12 also sing in choir. What is the probability a randomly chosen instrument player sings in choir?
In a survey of 100 students, 18 are both ninth graders and bus riders. What is their joint relative frequency?
Why can P(A given B) differ from P(B given A)?
choices: Both must use the entire sample as denominator
Conditional probabilities are always complementary
The conditions may select groups of different sizes
The order of the labels never changes the denominator

questions.question: A table shows 30 bus riders and 20 walkers in grade 9. Among randomly selected ninth graders, what is the probability of walking?
A table lists 24 club members who volunteer and 16 club members who do not. What fraction of club members volunteer?
A school has 60 ninth graders and 40 tenth graders. Of its 30 athletes, 18 are ninth graders. What is P(ninth grader given athlete)?
A school has 60 ninth graders and 40 tenth graders. Of its 30 athletes, 18 are ninth graders. What is P(athlete given ninth grader)?
Which comparison helps identify an association between grade level and club membership?
choices: Compare only the raw grade totals
Compare club-membership proportions within each grade
Compare the highest and lowest student ages
Compare the sum of every marginal total

questions.question: A table shows that 75% of one group and 25% of another prefer online reading. What does this suggest?
choices: An association between group and reading preference
Proof that group membership causes the preference
Identical conditional distributions
A calculation error because percentages must be equal

questions.question: A row contains 14 students who play sports and 21 who do not. What is the row total?
A survey has 80 students. Of 50 students with pets, 20 prefer hiking. Of 30 without pets, 15 prefer hiking. Which group has a higher hiking-preference rate?
choices: Students with pets: 40% versus 50%
Both groups: 25%
Students without pets: 50% versus 40%
Students with pets: 20% versus 15%

questions.question: Among 30 students who take art, 12 take music. Among 70 who do not take art, 28 take music. Which conclusion is supported by these data?
choices: Art students are twice as likely to take music
The music-taking rate is the same in both groups
Not taking art causes students to take music
The two groups contain the same number of students

questions.question: A survey lists 25 readers who exercise and 15 readers who do not. It also lists 10 nonreaders who exercise and 10 who do not. What is P(reader given exercises)?
At a school, 20 of 50 students in a morning class and 10 of 25 in an afternoon class bring lunch. What can be concluded?
choices: The morning rate is twice the afternoon rate
The afternoon rate is twice the morning rate
The rates are 20% and 10%
Both classes have a 40% lunch-bringing rate

questions.question: A table has cells 8 and 12 in its first row and 15 and 5 in its second row. What is the grand total?
